purpose: Appearance concepts, not CAD renders or a guarantee of printed finish.

prompts.label: hammered
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: product design concept rendering of a silk PLA 3D printed wall hanging.
Input image 1 is the edit target and the exact reference for the complete artwork. Preserve the exact distinctive curved manuscript M silhouette, proportions, position, thickness, and the white Celtic knot with blue edge lines and tan woven inserts behind it. Preserve the dark navy wall, near-front camera, and soft upper-left lighting. Do not replace the M with a normal typeface. Change ONLY the broad outward-facing copper M surface texture; preserve smooth shiny copper sidewalls and a very narrow clean 1 mm border around the M. Copper should look like warm copper-red silk PLA with directional sheen, not mirror-plated metal. These are appearance concepts for practical FDM printing with a 0.4 mm nozzle and 0.2 mm layer heights: show slight plausible layer stepping in close-up, no impossibly smooth microscopic relief, no overhangs, no undercuts, no hair-thin strands, no fuzz, no patina, no paint, no changes to fasteners or seams.
Composition: full wall hanging clearly visible, same framing as reference, with a discreet rectangular enlarged detail inset at the lower-right over empty navy background. The detail shows a small part of this exact M surface and its smooth sidewall under the same lighting. Keep the inset away from the artwork. No labels, text, dimensions, arrows, watermarks. High-resolution product visualization.
Texture variant: shallow HAMMERED FACETS. Cover the M face with a continuous, irregular field of small shallow polygonal depressions, like subtly planished copper. Broad gently angled faces, approximately 4–6 mm across and only 0.4–0.6 mm deep, softened boundaries with no sharp raised spikes and no deep pits. The relief is understated relative to the letter thickness. Small alternating copper highlights across the face, showing how the intentional texture breaks up long flat reflections. Do not make stone, crumpled foil, reptile scales, large dents, or pebble bumps. Make the enlarged detail clearly reveal shallow faceted depressions and realistic printed layer terraces.

Texture variant: fine DIAGONAL FLUTING. Cover the M face with a continuous field of straight parallel diagonal shallow grooves running lower-left to upper-right at 45 degrees in image space. Approximately 2 mm pitch and 0.4 mm peak-to-valley relief, broad sloping shoulders and narrow rounded crests, no undercuts. The grooves stay uniformly aligned across the entire letter, clipped neatly at the narrow smooth border, rather than tracing the letter's outline. Strong but tasteful directional copper highlights; an intentionally engraved or lightly reeded copper look. Do not make a woven crosshatch, checkerboard, deep channels, woodgrain, or thin loose wires. The enlarged detail clearly reveals shallow broad sloped channels with subtle real FDM stepping.
